readme.note: Left badge + right badge + response chain demo. A generates a random number each tick and sends it to B, showing that number in its own left badge and whatever B responds with in its own right-side badge. B receives A's number, appends a random letter, and forwards the combined value to C, showing that combined value in its own left badge; B also acknowledges A's number with a response, and shows whatever C responds with in its own right-side badge. C receives B's value, shows it in both its left badge and right-side badge, and responds to B with a random number. Turn on both 'Show Simulation Values' and 'Show Script Badge' on this view (already on by default here) to see each node's left badge (explicitly set by its own script -- leftBadge is opt-in, just like rightBadge, with no display at all if a script doesn't return one) alongside its script-controlled right badge (last thing received back). Step Simulation a few times to watch values and responses ripple through.

parts.label: A - Generator
parts.description: Generates a new random number each tick and sends it to B. Shows whatever B responds with in the right-side badge (blue).

parts.label: B - Processor
parts.description: Receives A's number, appends a random letter, and forwards the combined value to C. Acknowledges A with a response. Shows whatever C responds with in the right-side badge (purple).

parts.label: C - Receiver
parts.description: Receives B's combined value, shows it in the right-side badge (green), and responds to B with a random number.
